## prompt-1-mermaid

*Generated by Process A (the bootstrap milestone) from the single master prompt
in [`../prompts/prompt-protocol.md`](../prompts/prompt-protocol.md), adapting the
Phase I `trial-protocol` mermaid stage to the Phase II, multicenter, randomized,
controlled protocol. Runs in stage `trial-phase-2/mermaid/`.*

Author the **Stage 1 Mermaid figure catalog** for the *Phase 2, Multicenter,
Randomized, Controlled Clinical Trial Protocol of On-Premises LLM-Directed
Robotic Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple) with Perioperative Daraxonrasib
(RMC-6236) in KRAS-Mutated Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma* into
`trial-phase-2/mermaid/`.

**Scope.** Produce **at least 20** new, comprehensive, professional Mermaid
diagrams, each in its own Markdown file (`fig-NN-slug.md`) that opens with a real
```mermaid``` fenced block so it renders natively in GitHub, followed by a short
caption, the figure's role in the protocol, and the exact `trial-phase-2` and
`trial-protocol` source files the figure draws from. Every figure must be **new
to this protocol**; do not re-use any prior author figure development. All
quantitative content (sample size, hazard ratio, power, force caps, vessel zones,
timings, advisory windows, USL thresholds, co-investment levers) must be carried
from the locked Phase II constants so each diagram is comprehensive.

**Color scheme (every figure).** Burgundy `#800020` for end goals, the
investigational system, and operative or analytic decisions; Charcoal `#2E2E2E`
for harm or raw-data nodes; Slate Gray `#6B6B6B` for process and oversight nodes;
Mist Gray `#C9C9C9` for decision nodes and warnings; Cloud `#F5F5F5` for inputs
and context; white backgrounds and black rules elsewhere. Burgundy `#800020` is
the document color. These five `classDef` roles map one-to-one onto the TikZ node
styles in `protostyle.sty` (`mmgoal`, `mmdark`, `mmstep`, `mmdec`, `mmin`), so
emphasis must read by fill and stroke weight alone.

**Required figure families (expand to 20+; each comprehensive and Phase II).**
1. Overall randomized multicenter trial schema (screen -> central randomization
   1:1 -> Arm A and Arm B -> follow-up with BICR -> PFS/OS endpoints).
2. CONSORT randomized two-arm participant flow (about 245 screened -> 220
   randomized -> 110 per arm -> ITT/mITT/per-protocol/safety).
3. Combined IND/IDE regulatory pathway with the Subpart J overlay at the RP2D
   (Phase 2 efficacy), single IRB across the eight sites.
4. Stratified randomization and the eight-site multicenter design (strata:
   resectability, KRAS allele, neoadjuvant, site; BICR adjudication).
5. On-premises LLM advisory control loop (sensors -> mapping -> LLM advisory ->
   safety gate -> actuators; second-opinion oracle isolation; federated audit).
6. Eight-arm PancreSpeed II platform architecture (56 DOF, 640 sensor channels).
7. Five-vessel vascular safety-zone gate (no_fly / soft_warning / hard_stop).
8. Heartbeat / watchdog / E-stop safety architecture (10 kHz, 100 us watchdog,
   3 ms cross-arm halt, 18 N and 3 N caps, 500 ms hardware E-stop).
9. Daraxonrasib perioperative pause-and-restart advisory at the RP2D (T+7 / T+14
   / T+21 keyed to ISGPS fistula grade and serum trough).
10. Objectives-to-endpoints hierarchy (primary PFS; key secondary hierarchy of
    OS, R0, ISGPS B/C, MPR, ctDNA; secondary; exploratory).
11. Three reconstructive anastomoses (PJ, HJ, GJ) with ring-tension bands.
12. VVUQ ten-gate assurance pipeline (ACCEPT / BLOCK / ESCALATE).
13. Group-sequential interim analysis and analysis populations (O'Brien-Fleming
    efficacy and futility boundaries; DSMB device-safety halt rules).
14. Schedule of Activities visit map across both arms (screen, randomization,
    surgery, acute, day 30, day 90, long-term to 24-month OS).
15. Adverse-event and Physical AI AE reporting workflow (7-day / 15-day; six
    Subpart J triggers; federated audit preservation window).
16. Multicenter governance and safety oversight (Coordinating Center, single IRB,
    DSMB, Physical AI Safety Review Committee, Independent Safety Monitor, CRO).
17. Informed-consent process with the Physical AI opt-out (21 CFR 312.60(f)).
18. Staged-autonomy model at USL greater than or equal to 8.0 (clinician
    controlled -> supervised semiautonomous; full autonomy prohibited).
19. The four counterfactual scenarios (three clinical PFS/OS scenarios plus the
    under-funded, under-powered scenario answered by aligned co-investment).
20. The nine Physical AI concerns and their mitigations (the eight prior concerns
    plus financial influence and inequitable access).
21. Co-investment to success-likelihood mapping (capital -> operational levers ->
    power, retention, fidelity, equity, generalizability).
22. Capital-firewall governance (funders walled off from randomization,
    endpoints, adjudication, analysis, and publication).
23. ctDNA (KRAS) clearance and biomarker monitoring timeline (baseline, week 12).
24. Federated learning and federated hash-chained audit across the eight sites.

**Commit schedule.** One commit per figure file, pushed in real time (20+
commits). The second-to-last commit fixes all errors across every figure file.
The last commit writes `trial-phase-2/mermaid/README.md` (badges, repository
structure, the colored build Mermaid, a figure inventory table naming each source
file) and `output-mermaid.md` (the narrative output under an `## output-mermaid`
heading). Do not stall, ask questions, or go into plan mode.
